{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing values in either flipper_length_mm or body_mass_g
complete_cases = penguins.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g'])

# Check the number of complete cases
print("Number of complete cases:", len(complete_cases))

# Compute Pearson correlation
correlation = complete_cases['flipper_length_mm'].corr(complete_cases['body_mass_g'])
print(f"Pearson correlation: {correlation}")"}
